## Context / Problem
Condense 29 allowlisted prose blocks across exactly 11 integration-test paths while retaining current, non-obvious contracts. Inventory and before-citations stay pinned to origin/main@0033662b5534531d84e39d4a14bf75c8e768e85e; all scoped blobs are byte-identical at origin/main@d6669496cae441fc8381b5ee6de21a3993defd84. Implement in one commit, so path checks use HEAD^..HEAD.

## Approach
Edit only ordinary comments/docstrings at the anchors below; executable statements, assertions, runtime strings, directives, and unlisted prose are immutable. Strip only leading docstrings and normalize only ast.TypeIgnore.lineno before exact AST comparison; compare directives separately.

A non-author reviewer posts one leaf-linked row per edited block:
path<TAB>anchor/kind<TAB>before-citation<TAB>after-citation<TAB>preserved-contract-or-consumer<TAB>before-words<TAB>after-words<TAB>semantic-preservation<TAB>bloat-removal<TAB>reviewer-session
Use full before/final SHAs and PASS in both verdict columns.

## Scope — 29 editable blocks
- tests/integration/rebar_reconciler/conftest.py — _default_jira_project docstring. Preserve required project value, override behavior, and cleanup.
- tests/integration/rebar_reconciler/jira_contract/_fakes.py — module, FakeAcliClient, and install docstrings. Preserve captured shapes, deep-copy isolation, matching signatures, and the production injection seam.
- tests/integration/rebar_reconciler/jira_contract/test_jira_fixtures.py — module docstring and comment beginning “Ticket 88d9 INVERTED…”. Preserve complementary secret scrubbing and the top-level-parent presence/falsy oracle.
- tests/integration/rebar_reconciler/jira_contract/test_roundtrip.py — module docstring. Preserve the production-path bidirectional comment/link/parent round trip.
- tests/integration/rebar_reconciler/jira_contract/test_snapshot_contract.py — module docstring plus docstrings of test_producer_carries_enrichment_keys and test_inbound_reads_comment_field_and_would_miss_prefix. Preserve producer/consumer shape and discriminating nested-comment/link/parent oracles.
- tests/integration/rebar_reconciler/jira_contract/test_verified_fake_contract.py — module docstring and comment beginning “The honesty mechanism…”. Preserve shared-contract execution and the divergent-fake negative control.
- tests/integration/rebar_reconciler/test_leaves_invocable.py — module and test_outbound_probe_leaf_genuinely_invocable docstrings. Preserve linkage versus observable invocability.
- tests/integration/rebar_reconciler/test_link_sync.py — module and both test docstrings. Describe implemented bidirectional ADD-only link synchronization, not DESIRED/TDD/not-yet-implemented wording; retain Jira direction and representative payload shape.
- tests/integration/rebar_reconciler/test_post_deletion_linkage.py — module docstring, comment beginning (“inbound”, “delete”)…, and test_leaves_registry_linkage_intact docstring. Preserve the surviving leaf registry and linkage-versus-invocability scope.
- tests/integration/rebar_reconciler/test_reconcile_idempotency.py — module docstring, clock comment in test_unchanged_second_pass_preserves_binding_store_bytes_and_head, and test_out_of_window_404_then_alive_roundtrip_clears_absence docstring. Preserve non-vacuous git-backed setup, lifecycle clock injection, and two-pass zero-write behavior.
- tests/integration/rebar_reconciler/test_reconcile_roundtrip.py — module docstring, comment beginning “Ticket 4af8…”, description/oversize-description/link-roundtrip test docstrings, and comment beginning “Apply the link to the Jira snapshot…”. Preserve chained fixed-point purpose, ADF truncation protection, link direction, and no-churn/no-echo outcomes.

## Consumers and protected directives
Pytest executes nine modules; conftest.py supplies fixtures; _fakes.py is imported by four jira_contract modules; scripts/check_comment_hygiene.py consumes prose. No targeted runtime documentation consumer was found.

Preserve exact attachment for four directives: one # type: ignore[union-attr] in test_link_sync.py, two ignores in test_reconcile_idempotency.py (union-attr and attr-defined), and one union-attr ignore in test_reconcile_roundtrip.py.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Only the 29 allowlisted blocks or adjacent blank lines change.
- [ ] Every edited block is shorter.
- [ ] Every edited block contains only current, non-obvious rationale or constraints.
- [ ] Normalized ASTs exactly equal the immutable basis.
- [ ] All four directives retain exact text and attachment.
- [ ] Runtime strings remain AST-identical.
- [ ] HEAD^..HEAD changes exactly the 11 file-impact paths.
- [ ] The non-author TSV has one PASS/PASS row per edited block with full SHAs.
- [ ] Every command below and every persisted structured verify command exits 0.

## Verification
Run this complete zsh block from the leaf worktree. It gives literal runnable commands equivalent to the persisted seven-row contract.

~~~zsh
BASE=0033662b5534531d84e39d4a14bf75c8e768e85e
R=tests/integration/rebar_reconciler
paths=(
$R/conftest.py
$R/jira_contract/_fakes.py
$R/jira_contract/test_jira_fixtures.py
$R/jira_contract/test_roundtrip.py
$R/jira_contract/test_snapshot_contract.py
$R/jira_contract/test_verified_fake_contract.py
$R/test_leaves_invocable.py
$R/test_link_sync.py
$R/test_post_deletion_linkage.py
$R/test_reconcile_idempotency.py
$R/test_reconcile_roundtrip.py
)
tests=(${paths[@]:2})

# semantic AST equality
rtk proxy env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" .venv/bin/python -c 'import ast,subprocess,sys
base,*ps=sys.argv[1:]
class S(ast.NodeTransformer):
 def generic_visit(self,n):
  n=super().generic_visit(n)
  if isinstance(n,(ast.Module,ast.ClassDef,ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) and n.body and isinstance(n.body[0],ast.Expr) and isinstance(n.body[0].value,ast.Constant) and isinstance(n.body[0].value.value,str): n.body=n.body[1:]
  if isinstance(n,ast.TypeIgnore): n.lineno=0
  return n
def tree(ref,p):
 s=subprocess.check_output(["git","show",f"{ref}:{p}"],text=True)
 return ast.dump(S().visit(ast.parse(s,type_comments=True)),include_attributes=False)
bad=[p for p in ps if tree(base,p)!=tree("HEAD",p)]
if bad: raise SystemExit(f"normalized AST changed: {bad}")' "$BASE" "${paths[@]}"

# directive text and attachment
rtk proxy env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" .venv/bin/python -c 'import io,re,subprocess,sys,tokenize
base,*ps=sys.argv[1:]; pat=re.compile(r"#\s*(?:noqa\b|type:\s*ignore\b|pragma:\s*no cover\b|fmt:|ruff:|pyright:|mypy:)")
def sig(ref,p):
 s=subprocess.check_output(["git","show",f"{ref}:{p}"],text=True); lines=s.splitlines(); out=[]
 for t in tokenize.generate_tokens(io.StringIO(s).readline):
  if t.type!=tokenize.COMMENT or not pat.match(t.string): continue
  row,col=t.start; left=lines[row-1][:col].rstrip()
  anchor=("inline",left) if left else ("next",next((x.strip() for x in lines[row:] if x.strip() and not x.lstrip().startswith("#")),"<EOF>"))
  out.append((t.string,anchor))
 return out
bad=[p for p in ps if sig(base,p)!=sig("HEAD",p)]
if bad: raise SystemExit(f"directive text/attachment changed: {bad}")' "$BASE" "${paths[@]}"

# exact one-commit path set
rtk proxy env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" .venv/bin/python -c 'import subprocess,sys
expected=sorted(sys.argv[1:]); actual=sorted(subprocess.check_output(["git","diff","--name-only","HEAD^..HEAD"],text=True).splitlines())
if actual!=expected: raise SystemExit(f"path mismatch: {actual!r} != {expected!r}")' "${paths[@]}"

# scoped diff and policy
rtk git diff --check HEAD^ HEAD -- "${paths[@]}"
rtk proxy env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" .venv/bin/python scripts/check_comment_hygiene.py

# focused and full verification
rtk proxy env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest -q "${tests[@]}"
rtk proxy env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make verify
~~~
